text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While drafting a training regimen,
I felt eyes on me and looked up...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Right, right, gotcha.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't mind me!
Keep going, keep going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she walked away.
...What was that all about?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, Trainer!
You dropped your book!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's a whole lotta research to do...! Where's your desk? I'll help carry them!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're deep in thought even while eating...
That's amazing! Is there anything I can do to help?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My hands paused from flipping through the technical manual
while eating. I'm glad for the help, but...
choice_data_list: Why are you helping me out?
Why are you helping me out?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ahhh,
you mean 'cause I'm not your trainee?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, 'cause I thought it looked great!
Your side profile, that is!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Look at that! That's your serious face for the sake of your Umamusume!
The face of someone searching for the absolute best way!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Thinking, "How can I make them happy? How can I help them improve?" A face glowing with heartfelt warmth from thinking so hard!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh man...!
My heart feels so toasty warm, ya hear me--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her carefree smile was proof of her true feelings.
Listening to her earnest explanation, I couldn't help but feel a little flattered.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: That's why I thought I'd lend a hand. What do you say? Will ya let me help out?
choice_data_list: It's pretty tough, are you alright...?
Definitely! You might get some great tips!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You betcha!
Time to unleash that Umamusume power at full blast!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Whether it's heavy lifting or running errands far away, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! Could that be the signature trainer move—
"The sudden bolt of inspiration"!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I've always wanted to see the real deal!
Show me! Please let me see itーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a rumor like that...?
I'm not sure if it's my specialty per se,
but I suppose I do get flashes of inspiration quite often...?
